class_definitions.verification: work the decision table ought to model, including the statement compression its own footnote calls verification
class_definitions.application: work the decision table should not model

source_definitions.measured: a charge the runtime made during the transaction under measurement, read from the VM register trace with the argument registers that fixed the price, or from the compute meter either side of the charge site
source_definitions.derived: computed from committed code rather than observed on its own line

mapping.chosen: The Batching cell at n=2 is compared against two solo transact transactions, so both sides carry two Groth16 proofs over the same statements and no line is halved. The Recursion cell at n=2 is compared against one aggregate_transact over 2 legs, which is the shape that column names.
mapping.refused: Dividing the Batching cell by its proof count. The fold's pairing charge is one padded eight-pair call, not two things, and contract.rs::groth_msm reaches unreachable!() at n=1, so the model cannot be evaluated at the only Groth16 shape zolana sends today.
mapping.shape_difference: A table row is n proofs verified inside one transaction. zolana sends either one leg with one Groth16 proof, or one recursive proof attesting n leg statements plus the full state machine of all n legs.

findings.text: Point decompression is charged by no cell. A single G2 decompression is 13710 of it, 12.0 percent of a real leg and 32.3 percent of the whole n=2 Batching cell. contract.rs emits no compression operation and the B5 schedule states no decompression constant.

The B5 run still pays the stock decompression price, because the B5 schedule has nothing to say about it. If the IFMA kernel decompresses faster, 13710 CU per proof is an overcharge of unknown size. Unmeasured and not closed here.

The table reads 3.70x from Current to Batching B5 at n=2. On the real transaction the same schedule change is 1.47x, 333880 to 227880. The batching claim holds; 65 percent of a real leg is work no column touches.
STRUCTURE-TABLE.md puts the n=2 Batching cell at 87.0 percent syscall. On a real leg the BN254 syscalls are 39492 of 113940, 34.7 percent.

Every CPI that touches the 1185728-byte pool tree account pays len/250 for translating it. That is 11.2 percent of the whole n=2 cell and it scales with the tree account, not with the proof or the column.

18078 Poseidon plus 6974 guest sBPF, 22.0 percent of a leg, invariant across all six columns. It exists because every zolana verifying key declares exactly one public input. OPERATIONS-TABLE.md carries the Poseidon half in a footnote and the sBPF half nowhere.
The recursion cell charges 16 CU of fr_lincomb for the BSB22 reduction. The real program runs the ark-ff loop in the guest for 13208 CU.

The cell models one padded eight-pair check. The real recursion verifier issues two, four pairs for the Groth16 equation and two for the BSB22 proof of knowledge. Padding both into one lane is available and unused, worth 11150 CU.
5513 for the Batching cell against 571 of real verifier sBPF, and 7740 for the recursion cell against 13629. The residual is 13.0 and 17.6 percent of its cell, so it is not a rounding term.
contract.rs::bsb22_hash_to_field() prices three calls at 379 CU and the three measured sol_sha256 calls cost 379 CU.
The schedule charges 23505 for four pairs and the measured four-pair check costs 23505. The syscall core of the table is sound.

limits: The synthetic-guest residuals 5513 and 7740 were not re-measured here. They are read from residuals.json and STRUCTURE-TABLE.md, and they are produced by a pipeline this session does not own.
The Batching model cannot be evaluated at n=1, k=1, so no cell exists at the shape zolana actually sends. contract.rs::groth_msm reaches unreachable!() there.
No B5 tariff exists for point decompression, so the 14706 CU per proof is a stock charge inside a B5 measurement. The size of the B5 opportunity there is unknown.

The three CPI sub-lines are a derived split of a measured 7927 CU window. The split is confirmed on the translation term by the account length, and on the invoke base by DEFAULT_INVOCATION_COST, but the 150 CU system-program builtin is taken from the runtime rather than isolated on its own line.

Every cell figure was read from bn254-decision-bench as the worktree holds it today, which another session is editing. The recomputation reproduces the published TRANSACTION-TABLE.md and STRUCTURE-TABLE.md cells exactly, so the two agree at the time of writing, but a later edit there moves the cell side of both ladders and not the measured side.
